topic: Concurrency and Sync Primitives for Threads and Processes
explanation: Concurrency involves multiple threads or processes executing seemingly at the same time.  Synchronization primitives are mechanisms used to coordinate the access of shared resources by these concurrent entities, preventing race conditions and ensuring data consistency.  In computer systems architecture, this is crucial for efficient utilization of multi-core processors and for managing access to shared memory.
